articles.title: Does JTEKT's Upgraded Outlook And Toyota Industries Stake Sale Plan Change The Bull Case For JTEKT (TSE:6473)?
articles.summary: In February 2026, JTEKT Corporation reported earnings for the nine months to December 31, 2025, with sales of ¥1,403,324 million and net income of ¥21,349 million, while its board met to consider tendering all Toyota Industries Corporation shares it holds into a tender offer. Alongside stronger profits and higher earnings per share, JTEKT raised its full-year earnings forecast, pointing to margin gains and benefits from weaker yen assumptions.
